notes.title: New 7-card pack for Christmas
notes.content:
Christmas is here and to celebrate we're releasing 7 new cards! The new 7 cards will be included free of cost in your copy of Draconian Wars, just wait until Steam updates it. Take a look at all the cards included in the pack here http://cloud-4.steampowered.com/ugc/28476970131420931/6645F568134D9E7531EFCD37381CBCC6E9BC4E02/

[h1]Control and brutality; science and magic[/h1]
Part of the beauty of Draconian Wars is that each faction approaches differently the war for Hyperborea. Technocrats rely on their knowledge, technology, and thorough battle plans. The Cartographer clearly represents this philosophy. This small ground unit gives a combat fate penalty to your opponent for each ground zone you control. If you spread your units, you can get up to -2 penalty, which can be the difference between winning or losing, or between damaging a strong unit or a weak one. A brave commander will send weak units to empty zones just to get quick control over them. Then start a combat where the Cartographer is. And in the move phase maneuver his units to avoid opponent's retaliation.

The inventors also get a new reinforcement, the Metachemist. This specialized units finds his place among those who master the combat planning. Moreover, since he's an Inventor, Marguerite can improve his extraction capabilities.

On the other hand, Draconians send lesser units carelessly to the battlefield. These beasts do not hesitate to feed on each other to become stronger. The Gigagons excel at this. This pack includes the new Carnivorous Gigagon, which comes with an intimidating force of 7, and two powerful abilities. The first one allows it to become Shielded by sacrificing a comrade. The second one damages a small opposing unit, discarding just one card! To reinforce the Gigagons, from the wetlands of Hyperborea comes the Marsh Salamander. These salamanders like to hunt their preys in groups, if you spot one, be prepared to face a whole pack of them. Moreover, whenever a Marsh Salamander is sacrificed you Recover one. Making any Gigagon army even more powerful.

Where Technocrats use gadgets, Draconians employ enchantments. The magic of Draconians warlocks increases as more of them gather. The Dreadful Warlock uses this power to bring back to live fallen comrades. As long as you keep the power of magic stronger than the power of science, your opponents will have to face your units over and over again.

Discover these 5 cards and two more (Narrow Escape and Call the Eagles) in the new pack and get ready to spend these holidays in Hyperborea.

notes.title: New patch with new cards
notes.content:
To thank all Draconian Wars players for their patience with those pesky bugs, today we're launching a new patch that fixes a number of bugs and includes seven new cards. These seven cards will be added to your game for free. The list of updates of the patch is as follows:
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that caused challenges to crash randomly.
[*]Fixed a number of bugs that affected skirmishes against the AI.
[*]Seven new cards:
[list]
[*]Red Wing Corsair
[*]Navigator Emblem
[*]Rapid Deployment
[*]Cyclonic Storm
[*]Talisman Of Devotion
[*]Mark Of The Rider
[*]Experimental Pilot
[/list]
[*]Added a new skirmish that employs some new cards introduced in this patch.
[*]Fixed some typos in the English and Spanish versions of the game.
[/list]

We hope you enjoy the strategical possibilities that these new cards bring to the table.

The Kardfy Team.

notes.title: New patch released
notes.content:
And another patch has been uploaded with the following fixed issues: 
- Cards player owns are not showed on the shop anymore.
- New option to exclude foils on the shop. 
- Fixed a bug on the deck editor that showed wrong cost and fate distributions.
- Rewarded cards after completing a match are now properly saved.

notes.title: New patch released
notes.content:
We just uploaded a new patch with the following fixed issues:
- Card effects with randomness (for example, Cyrus McCormick's ability) could make the AI crash. This has been fixed.
- A Second Opportunity now works as intended.
- With certain resolutions, during the advanced tutorial some windows may block a card making it impossible to finish. Help windows have been moved so this doesn't happen.
- Completing the tutorials now unlocks the achievement.
- Minor language issues.
Your copy of the game should be updated soon.
